title: Evolutionary Multi-Task Optimization for LLM-Guided Program Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2605.22613v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent LLM-guided evolutionary search methods have shown that iterative program mutation can discover strong algorithms, but they typically optimize each task independently, even when related tasks share reusable structure. We study evolutionary multitask optimization (EMO) for LLM-guided program discovery and propose EMO-STA (Shared-Then-Adapt), a two-stage framework that first evolves a shared archive of executable programs across a task family and then adapts selected shared candidates to each target task. Within EMO-STA, we explore multiple adaptation strategies, including warm-starting from the shared archive, adapting the best average shared program, and adapting the shared program that performs best on each target task. translated_title: 面向LLM引导程序发现的进化多任务优化
translated_abstract: 近年来的LLM引导进化搜索方法表明，迭代式程序变异能够发现强大的算法，但这些方法通常对每个任务独立优化，即使相关任务之间存在可复用的结构。我们研究了面向LLM引导程序发现的进化多任务优化（EMO），并提出了EMO-STA（Shared-Then-Adapt，先共享后适配），这是一个两阶段框架：首先在整个任务族上演化出一个可执行程序的共享档案库，然后将选定的共享候选程序适配到每个目标任务。在EMO-STA框架内，我们探索了多种适配策略，包括从共享档案库热启动、适配平均表现最好的共享程序，以及适配在目标任务上表现最好的共享程序。在涵盖连续优化、几何构造、建模和算法优化的八个任务族上，在相同的进化迭代预算下，EMO-STA的表现优于单任务进化方法……
tldr: 提出EMO-STA两阶段框架，先跨任务族演化出共享程序档案库，再将共享候选程序适配到各目标任务，在八个任务族上以相同的进化迭代预算超越了单任务进化方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes EMO-STA, a two-stage evolutionary multi-task framework that first evolves a shared program archive across a task family and then adapts shared candidates to each target task, outperforming single-task evolution under matched budgets across eight task families.
